translations.web: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.
translations.bsb: Yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more; though you look for them, they will not be found.
translations.kjv: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place,
translations.asv: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: Yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and he shall not be.
